main_claim: Conditional form-to-function mapping across nuclear-history-constrained Cirsium natural contrasts
primary_historical_question: Are orientation at anthesis and true phyllary spine/opening independently or contingently changing among lineages?
primary_ecological_question: Can distinct head configurations yield equivalent multi-component performance within a realized climate-and-guild context?

trait_states.O_deg: gravity-referenced axis angle at tagged capitulum; bud, anthesis and fruit separate sessions
trait_states.B_spine_projection_mm: calibrated actual spine-tip projection, not phyllary posture or image outline
trait_states.B_aperture_mm: measured access gap/outer phyllary posture, separate from spine length
trait_states.S_stickiness: auxiliary, not synonymous with physical spine or gap

independent_sampling_unit: maternal plant (nested head and visits); sites and years additional hierarchy

minimal_outcomes.pollination: conspecific pollen deposited on identified stigma/floret, actual observation exposure
minimal_outcomes.antagonism: verified oviposition or seed injury; denominator eligible inspected heads/achenes
minimal_outcomes.final_maternal_fitness_component: mature filled viable achene yield for complete mother cohort if achievable; otherwise label head-limited
minimal_outcomes.optional: germination potential; pollen-siring success if separately assayed

causal_estimand: Effect of randomized non-damaging head orientation change relative to sham, conditional on baseline bract morphology and measured site/guild context. Non-randomized B is effect modifier, not identified direct cause.
primary_interaction: orientation treatment x pre-treatment B (exact one B axis selected after outcome-blind geometry pilot, subject to adequate independent mothers)
conditional_equivalence_rule: Morphological separation above measurement error AND all preselected 90 percent mother-level confidence intervals for functional endpoints strictly inside independently predeclared biologically meaningful equivalence margins. No difference p-value is not equivalence.
compensation_rule: If matched maternal final seed yields pass predeclared equivalence but pollen/antagonism differences are substantial, label equal net reproductive component with distinct pathways; do not label identical function or causal compensation.
context_dependence_rule: Compare the orientation intervention effect in genuinely replicated guild/environment strata, testing an interaction or held-out site effect. Nonrandomized guild variation requires confounding limits.
phylogeny_propagation: Use published nuclear tree ensemble plus admitted within-lineage RAD ancestry as separate validated strata; time-calibrate before per-Myr evolutionary rates; BM baseline and power-gated OU; do not call OU theta experimental fitness peak.
numerical_precision_formula: NormalDist.inv_cdf(0.95) * sd_of_independent_mother_contrast / sqrt(n_mothers) for 90% approximate normal CI; excludes site/year/measurement-error design effects
data_ingested: No original morphology/pollen/seed/head IDs used to calculate precision scenarios
